response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS group_avg FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE o.amount > 2802 GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.group_avg AS avg_amount, g.group_avg - overall.overall_avg AS difference FROM g CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
